NOTIFICATIONS
Here is where you can stay up-to-date with current announcements, programs and other changes.
Announcements
Discount Schedules and Drying Charts
Discount schedules and drying charts are subject to change. Online schedules are provided for reference only. Please refer to your local scale room or the office for the authoritative schedule in effect.
Grain Programs
Programs
Corn: Condo, Cash or some type of contract. Wheat & Soybeans: $.08/bu/month/no minimum fee/2 week grace period (if grain stays on PL, charges start from day of 1st delivery) You may price the grain any time before the close of the market on June 21, 2027, but it will be sold on the open of the market June 22, 2027. All wheat and soybeans delivered will be applied to Contract, Condo, Price Later, Cash.
